Graduate Admissions – Important Deadlines
For questions or assistance with your graduate application, contact us at 302.857.8200 or email gradstudies [at] desu.edu.
Note: Individual graduate programs may have earlier deadlines and stricter requirements than the general deadlines listed below.
Please consult your Program Director for specific application requirements before submitting your materials.
